name: private web radar one-match release
features: HTTP radar UI and map assets served by the DLL on 127.0.0.1:6767
Copy Match Link, Renew Match Link, and End Match Link UI actions
automatic link shutdown after match telemetry is absent for 30 seconds
same map/player/ally/visibility/yaw telemetry as the in-game radar
signed Cloudflare helper verification before execution

runtime_helper.signature_requirement: Valid Authenticode chain and signer display name containing Cloudflare
